name: RulerLevels2
description: A collection of all the RulerLevel2 objects on the specified ruler.
remarks: Each RulerLevel2 object represents the first-line and left indent for text at a particular outline level. This collection always contains five members-one for each of the available outline levels.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Gets an Application object that represents the container application for the RulerLevels2 object. Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Gets a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the RulerLevels2 object was created. Read-only.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Gets the Parent object for the RulerLevels2 object. Read-only.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Gets a Long indicating the number of items in the RulerLevels2 collection. Read-only.

methods.name: Item
methods.description: Gets a member of the RulerLevels2 collection.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The index number of the object to be returned.
